svg.text: Cross-dataset EEG motor classification: test performance and spatial patterns
Six fixed test partitions; hyperparameters selected on validation data
Point = accuracy (%) · whisker = trial bootstrap 95% CI · red dashed = best of 15 models
Motor-area spectral contrast and channel profiles
PhysioNet: schematic 10–10 positions · BCI: electrode coordinates unavailable
Accuracy differences relative to reference methods
x = previous selected method · y = best of 15 reference models (percentage points)
Test accuracy change vs previous selected method (percentage points)
Unweighted mean across six tasks vs previous round
above the best of 15 reference models
No paired test vs historical models: trial-level predictions unavailable.
Color = true class · 120 PhysioNet trials/class · perplexity P = 25 (BCI IIIA: 16)

Topographies: subject-wise T1–T2 event-code difference in 8–30 Hz log power (dB), averaged equally over 22 test subjects. Gaussian interpolation is restricted to the 15-sensor convex hull; head locations are schematic.
t-SNE: standardized per-channel log power in five bands (8–12, 12–16, 16–20, 20–24, 24–30 Hz); 120 randomly sampled trials/class for PhysioNet, all test trials for BCI.

Accuracy CIs use trial bootstrap, not subject-clustered resampling. Paired tests vs historical models are unavailable. Fixed test partitions were examined previously; results are exploratory. t-SNE coordinates and inter-cluster distances are not quantitative.
